scenes.text: Have you ever noticed that every single banana you buy at the grocery store looks and tastes exactly the same?
Seriously, every Cavendish banana in the world is a genetic copy of a single plant grown in a British greenhouse in the 1830s.
Now, a new super-fungus called Tropical Race 4 is spreading across the globe, slowly killing off our current banana supply.
Do you think we will find a way to save the banana, or should we start saying goodbye?
